notes: Building fixes. A building the game has reserved (such as a new account's Academy) is now built on its reserved square instead of a second copy elsewhere. The builder no longer holds up the fleet while it waits for the server's answer, so large fleets keep their other automation on time. Gift-box claims and building requests no longer mix up each other's replies. Upgrades always go to the placed building, never to an unclaimed gift beside it. Building costs and requirements reload when the game updates its files, without a restart.
